analysis_results.training_data: The model was trained on tokenized chess game data prepared from the Lichess dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/lichess). Games were tokenized using a custom 32-token vocabulary for chess symbols/notations, and the resulting data was saved into binary files (train.bin and val.bin) with vocabulary metadata stored in meta.pkl. No dataset size or number of games is specified in the card.
analysis_results.model_architecture: GPT-based transformer language model implemented as GPT2LMHeadModel with approximately 4.5M parameters. It uses 8 transformer layers with 4 attention heads per layer and an embedding dimension of 256. The training sequence length is 1024 tokens per chess game (block size 1023 plus positional embedding), and it uses a custom 32-token vocabulary.
analysis_results.limitations: Because it is a relatively small 4.5M-parameter model, it may not capture extremely complex chess strategies. It is specialized for chess move generation and is not expected to generalize well to standard natural language tasks.
